name: trendy-youth-orange-studio
image_vibe: Playful premium streetwear against a vivid orange studio backdrop with tactile companion characters
image_purpose: Create a high-energy fashion editorial portrait for a youth streetwear campaign.

prompt.project_info: A hyper-realistic studio fashion portrait of an original adult man in modern streetwear leaning on an oversized fluffy designer-inspired plush character, with a British Shorthair cat nearby.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult man with contemporary Gen-Z-inspired minimal streetwear, relaxed posture, and a confident natural expression. Preserve realistic skin, hair, clothing, and full-body or mid-shot proportions without copying any reference identity.
prompt.composition_elements: The subject leans casually against a realistic life-sized fluffy fantasy plush companion with soft fur and a playful expression. A British Shorthair cat sits nearby with natural posture and detailed fur. Use a seamless vibrant orange studio backdrop and a clean premium fashion-editorial arrangement.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Professional studio lighting with crisp but controlled shadows, clean highlights on fur and clothing, saturated orange background, playful yet premium streetwear atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic high-detail fashion photography, full-body or mid-shot composition, accurate fur and textile texture, natural anatomy, polished color grading, high-resolution clarity, no logos, text, or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic high-detail studio fashion portrait of an original adult man in stylish minimal modern streetwear, leaning casually against a realistic life-sized fluffy fantasy plush companion with soft fur and a playful expression. Place a British Shorthair cat nearby with detailed fur and natural posture. Set the entire scene against a smooth seamless vivid orange studio backdrop with professional lighting, crisp controlled shadows, clean highlights, premium youth streetwear editorial styling, realistic skin and textile texture, full-body or mid-shot framing, high-resolution clarity, and no logos, text, or watermark. Use original character designs and do not copy any reference identity.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, copyrighted character logo or text, distorted anatomy, malformed animal, duplicate limbs, plastic fur, watermark

assets.name: source orange streetwear studio portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the orange backdrop, streetwear pose, plush companion, cat placement, and premium editorial mood; do not copy identity or protected character branding.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult streetwear subject, vivid orange studio, fluffy fantasy companion, British Shorthair cat, and playful premium mood. Use original character design without logos or protected branding.
